messages:
eli: Quick summary: ran a RoPE-scaling sweep across Llama-2-13B, mixtral-8x, and qwen-7b with linear / NTK / YARN variants. Observed a reproducible perplexity spike + latency cliff for mixtral-8x when the kernel selector picks headkv-shard over fast-attn-v2.

eli: Bench command I used:
```
./bench --model mixtral-8x --rope ntk --ctx 32768 --kernels auto --batch-size 8 --profile flame
```

eli: Results (median over 10 runs):
- fast-attn-v2: ppl 12.3, p50 42ms, p95 89ms
- headkv-shard:  ppl 18.9, p50 73ms, p95 210ms 
- cpu fallback:   ppl 19.5, p50 320ms, p95 900ms

eli: Note the perplexity reg is real (12.3 -> 18.9) not just timing. sample diffs show token-level drift after ~1k tokens.

maria: oof. is this with adaptive batching on? did kv cache eviction change?

eli: adaptive batching on (policy=aggressive), kv-evict=auto. I re-ran with batching off, headkv-shard still had higher ppl but latency gap closed slightly. kv-evict param changed nothing obvious.

nitya: shared profiler link: https://perf.internal/redwood/runs/2498765432/flame.svg (flame shows headkv-shard spends lots of time in head-slice & cuda memcopy around step 1024)

nitya: also saw KV cache churn: #kv-alloc ops spike at longctx boundary (~8192 tokens) which aligns w/ token drift window.

perf-bot: CI perf alert: mixtral-8x e2e regression detected on nightly-ropesweep. Test: longctx-generation-32k failed threshold (ppl delta +30%). Run id: ci-2026-03-17-87.

kevin: my theory: headkv-shard kernel relies on per-head KV packing that assumes original RoPE scaling; for NTK variant the effective rotary freq changes distribution -> aliasing in head-slice quantization -> affects softmax/numerics -> ppl regress. Also memory layout causes occasional memcopy ordering that interacts with caching.

kevin: immediate mitigation: force kernel selection to prefer fast-attn-v2 for mixtral-8x + NTK until we validate headkv-shard fix.

maria: can we add a model-specific safe-range rule? e.g. if model==mixtral-8x and rope in [ntk, yarn] -> prefer kernel fast-attn-v2. We already have per-model kernel prefs in catalog.

tori: sounds reasonable. quick experiment idea: run headkv-shard with increased head-kv-dim clamp (double clamp) and disable headpacking to see if numeric error goes away. command:
```
ROPE_VARIANT=ntk ./bench --model mixtral-8x --kernel headkv-shard --headkv-clamp 2.0 --disable-headpack --ctx 32768
```

eli: ran that: ppl improved 18.9 -> 13.0 but still slightly off from fast-attn. latency increased ~1.3x but stable. suggests numerical instability from packing.

nitya: added a small repro in /tmp/mixtral-ntk-repro with seed 42, context 12k. Pushing to git branch bench/mixtral-rope-repro.

kevin: plan proposal:
1) hotfix: set per-model kernel preference in model-catalog for mixtral-8x (prefer fast-attn-v2 for NTK/YARN).
2) triage subtask: debug headkv-shard packing + numeric test vector (assigned nitya).
3) perf test: run longctx nightly with gating rule to prevent auto-switch to headkv-shard until validated.
4) longer term: add kernel-aware RoPE scaling transforms in compiler to avoid packing mismatch.

eli: +1 to all. I'll open the hotfix PR and add an instrumented test to catch ppl divergence > 1.5x.

maria: please add a note to release notes and alert support (some customers on mixtral dedicated might hit this).

perf-bot: ticket created: PERF-1432 (mixtral headkv-shard RoPE NTK regression). Assigned: nitya, label: p0.

tori: if anyone wants to re-run quick local repro: I left a small container in /workers/fast1 with bench + data. ping me and i'll give access. :sparkles:

eli: thanks all. will post PR link once ready.
